name: gap_aware_ranking
hypothesis: Stage C-v0 的高 regret 部分源于训练目标未充分强调大 utility gap；加入 utility-gap-aware pairwise ranking term 将在不改变输入与架构的情况下改善 Val 的 regret/headroom，同时保持或提升 recognition metrics。
core_change: Add one stay-inclusive utility-gap-weighted pairwise ranking term to the existing Set Ranker objective; no architecture, feature, sampler, or upstream protocol change.
baseline: Stage C-v0 SetUtilityRanker with SmoothL1 regression plus stay-inclusive listwise ranking
notes: Research experiment created; human review required before start.
